blind.second_guess: rocky cave-in debris with wooden beam
blind.description: A dense, angular mound of collapsed rock blocks, gravel, and earth debris, with a broken, splintered wooden beam or mine timber protruding from the upper slope. The stones are stylized with clean chiseled facets, painted in varying shades of muted brown, charcoal, and grey stone with fine grit packing the crevices. The rear and side feature a steep, sheer rocky wall formation, while the front slopes down toward the ground.
blind.from_above: A roughly rectangular cluster of blocky, faceted stones and rock rubble with a broken wooden post sticking out near the center, casting a long shadow toward the top-left.
defects: a few tiny rock fragments near the outer edges appear almost detached or floating
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4 to 4.5 feet tall (roughly three-quarters the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4 to 5 feet wide across its base.
